name: Spirit Talk - Cozy Visual Novel
source: Cozy visual novel about a lovely witch who’s able to talk to spirits in a fantasy setting. Using her powers, Julia helps her neighbors in their daily whereabouts. Craft potions, find the right time to use them and get to know both spirits and clients to find their peace.
translation: 舒适的视觉小说，讲述了一位可爱的女巫能够在奇幻环境中与灵魂交谈的故事。朱莉娅利用她的力量帮助邻居了解他们的日常行踪。制作药剂，找到合适的时间使用它们，并了解灵魂和客户以找到他们的平静。
